title: Escudella i carn d'olla
description: The most emblematic Catalan Christmas dish. A hearty soup of large galets pasta with a big meatball, vegetables and an assortment of meats, followed by the boiled meat (carn d'olla) as a second course.

instructions.title: Boil the meats
instructions.description: Boil all the meats and bones in a large pot with plenty of salted water and the vegetables (potatoes, carrots, celery, onion and cabbage) for about two hours, skimming off any foam that rises.

instructions.title: Make the meatball
instructions.description: Meanwhile, make the pilota by mixing the minced meat with chopped garlic and parsley, the egg and the breadcrumbs; shape into one large meatball and tie it with kitchen string.

instructions.title: Add the meatball
instructions.description: Add the meatball, chorizo and blood sausage to the broth and cook for a further 30 minutes.

instructions.title: Cook the galets
instructions.description: Strain the broth and boil the galets pasta in it for 10-12 minutes until al dente.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.description: Serve the soup first with the galets and a slice of meatball, then the meat and vegetables as a second course, accompanied by the chorizo and blood sausage.
